identification.summary: Crescent Typhoon is a Microsoft threat actor name for a China-origin actor; Microsoft's threat actor naming table lists its former name as CESIUM [S1].
identification.notes: Microsoft name: Crescent Typhoon (former Microsoft element-scheme name CESIUM) [S1]. No other-vendor names or MITRE ATT&CK group ID were found. No public Microsoft blog, Security Insider profile or Digital Defense Report text describing Crescent Typhoon or CESIUM activity turned up in searches.

attribution.basis: Microsoft's naming table classifies Crescent Typhoon's origin as China [S1]. Microsoft's public sources found here state no sponsoring organization or confidence level. No government attribution was found.

targeting.notes: Public sources found here describe no targeting for Crescent Typhoon or CESIUM.

diamond.adversary: China-origin actor that Microsoft tracks as Crescent Typhoon (formerly CESIUM) [S1]; no public detail on the operators.

gaps: No public reporting was found on Crescent Typhoon's activity, tooling, infrastructure, victims or campaigns. Microsoft's naming table lists only the name, origin (China) and the legacy name CESIUM.
First-observed date, sponsoring organization (MSS, PLA or contractor) and Microsoft's confidence level are not public in the sources found.

No other-vendor alias mapping (Mandiant, CrowdStrike, Secureworks, etc.) and no MITRE ATT&CK group entry were found. Do not merge Crescent Typhoon with other China clusters without a Microsoft statement linking them.
No public Microsoft blog post or Digital Defense Report text was found that names CESIUM in operational reporting. Element-era Microsoft reporting (pre-April 2023) may exist but was not located.

Primary-document access limits: the Microsoft naming page is cited from search-result content; S1's date is an access date. Microsoft's MSTIC GitHub mapping feed and the MISP Microsoft activity-group galaxy were not confirmed to contain this entry in fact-check searches and are not cited.
The imported record cites only Microsoft's naming page. Searches returned no news, vendor or government coverage of this actor.
